violation_type.title: Activities for School-age - Study Time (26 TAC §746.2707(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: I observed the after school children taken outdoors to the playground as soon as they are broughrt from school.  I asked the assistant director about this and she confirmed, they remain outdoors until their parent picks them up.
